content: UEFA Article 16 defines three valid branches: both host slots used gives 8 teams in 2 four-team single-leg semi-final/final paths for 2 places; one used gives 12 teams in 3 paths for 3 places; none used gives 8 teams in 4 seeded-vs-unseeded home-and-away ties for 4 places. Allocation is lowest-ranked qualifying-group runners-up first, then non-qualified Nations League A-C group winners by interim overall ranking, then eligible League D group winners if needed, then remaining highest-ranked Nations League teams. Articles 16-17 also define draw pots, host separation constraints, and match format.
